baseline.method: Twelve union-then-saved-overlay cycles; restart and clear only the owned lake disk cache before each cold query, wait six seconds for metrics, then run twenty warm queries. OS cache is retained. Verify table, ID, score and nonempty body highlights. Capture a stack above 750 ms.

warming_fault.impact: Malformed local progress repeatedly defers native checkpoint warming. One native table had an empty progress hint.
warming_fault.fix: Recover malformed optional progress as absent and atomically replace progress through a synced staging file. Preserve last complete state on cancellation. Retained generation authority is unchanged.
warming_fault.causality: This fault is independently reproduced and fixed; it does not establish the cause of the original latency sample.

limits: Shared development host with concurrent unrelated builds; no controlled before/after latency claim.
Lake-cache cold means owned lake cache files are cleared, not an OS cache purge.
Bounded native current fixture, not full-archive or Antfly Cloud qualification.

cold_probe.method: Twelve union-then-saved-overlay cycles, restart and clear only the owned lake disk cache before each cold query. Odd cycles issue the query immediately after readiness; even cycles wait six seconds. Then twenty warm queries verify exact table, ID, score, projected source and highlights. Metrics are sampled after a six-second refresh wait outside query timing. OS cache retained; shared host. Process resource counters include concurrent background work. Stack sampling triggers above 750 ms; stripped stacks cannot independently identify internal call sites.
cold_probe.slowest_request_attribution: First immediate union: 1,334.599 ms total; native leaf 998.381 ms; lake 324.854 ms. This is measured native execution, not proof of the historical saved-overlay stall cause.

warm_stall_followup.method: Ten saved-overlay restart/cache-clear cycles, wait six seconds before cold request and six seconds afterward, then twenty consecutive warm queries. Verify exact table, ID, score, source and highlights. Arm process sampling above 750 ms for every warm request. Collect process resource counters per request and phase counters per serial window; windows with multiple requests cannot attribute an individual request.
warm_stall_followup.conclusion: The 3324.86 ms full-matrix warm stall did not recur. This does not explain or erase its failed warm latency gate.
